authorization: GRI-02C implementation authorized by project decision; training was not authorized until this frozen declaration

architecture.readout: logits = O h + c after the query transition

operation_counting.transition_selector: frozen external token-semantic dispatch; counted as 0 candidate state operations

evaluation_modes.q8: frozen B rule: float32 transition arithmetic; quantize state after every recurrent step

ablations.no_preserve: same trained parameters; every token uses the ordinary tanh transform
ablations.no_transform: same trained parameters; every token uses identity, including information-changing tokens
ablations.no_recurrence: same trained parameters; reset h to zero before every active token, then apply candidate token semantics
ablations.credit_rule: each ablation must fail its named held-out criterion for every seed

verdict_inputs.candidate_preserve_pass: required-mode output accuracy is 1.0 on all preserve fixtures for every seed
verdict_inputs.candidate_transform_pass: required-mode output accuracy is 1.0 on all transform fixtures for every seed
verdict_inputs.candidate_fixed_decoder_pass: one LP decoder per task, fit on fit states only, is perfect with positive margin on fit and held-out states in every required mode and seed
verdict_inputs.candidate_precision_pass: candidate output and fixed-decoder gates pass in float64, float32, and q8
verdict_inputs.parent_opponent_pass: candidate required-mode held-out output passes while the same-seed parent fails at least one required-mode held-out output for every seed
verdict_inputs.stateless_opponent_pass: candidate required-mode held-out output passes while the same-seed stateless baseline fails at least one required-mode held-out output for every seed
verdict_inputs.no_preserve_ablation_failed: no-preserve fails a held-out preserve or transform output criterion for every seed
verdict_inputs.no_transform_ablation_failed: no-transform fails a held-out transform output criterion for every seed
verdict_inputs.no_recurrence_ablation_failed: no-recurrence fails a held-out recurrence-dependent output criterion for every seed
